2026-08-13GACUnited Nations ActRegulations Amending Certain Regulations Made Under the United Nations ActRegulations Amending Certain Regulations Made Under the United Nations Act in order to implement the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) resolutions by updating the Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan and Somalia regulations in order to fulfill Canada's international legal obligation to implement the binding decisions of the UNSC set out in certain Resolutions.Registration: SOR/2026-0180 Publication Date: 2026-08-26
subject: Regulations Amending Certain Regulations Made Under the United Nations Act
precis: Regulations Amending Certain Regulations Made Under the United Nations Act in order to implement the United Nations Security Council (UNSC) resolutions by updating the Central African Republic, Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan and Somalia regulations in order to fulfill Canada's international legal obligation to implement the binding decisions of the UNSC set out in certain Resolutions.
